source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; text transcribed from the page images (RapidOCR on page 1, corrected against the images; pages 2-3 read directly from the rendered images). The header prints only 'SCHOOL' (no school name). No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name (...-150323-2023) and the icseboard.org folder. Marks are printed only per group: groups whose marks would be fractional per item (I, II, III, IV, V, IX) are kept as one entry per group; groups that divide evenly (VI, VII, VIII) are split with marks from the group total. Listed marks total 40. Handwritten ticks on the scan, the Whatsapp advertisement on page 3, the icseonline.com footer and the icseboard.org watermark are ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Choose the correct answer.
1. India accounts for only 1% / 5% of the world's total production of natural gas.
2. Europe can be broadly divided into four / five major physical divisions.
3. Mt. Sedley is the highest / lowest volcano in Antarctica.
4. Transhumance is the seasonal / annual movement of people.
